_description: Contrato de performance de red/runtime para auditorias transversales de arranque y navegacion (ODE-358).
source_trace: baseline pendiente de captura real con /wf-audit-runtime; este budget fija el instrumento post ODE-353/ODE-357.

evaluation.warn_rule: warn if warn_lte < value <= fail_lte, or if a required metric has a small overrun up to grace_lte
evaluation.fail_rule: fail if value > grace_lte when grace_lte exists, otherwise if value > fail_lte
evaluation.approval_rule: A network audit is approved when every required metric is pass or warn and no required metric is fail.
evaluation.rejection_rule: A network audit is rejected when at least one required metric is fail or a required metric is missing.

total_requests.note: Post ODE-353/357 startup should stay bounded; legitimate product expansion must justify budget updates in the PR.

transfer_bytes.note: Target from docs/plan-mejoras-network-sync-2026-07.md is under 1 MB after M1-M3.

duplicate_identical_requests.note: Identical startup requests are never acceptable; they indicate lost single-flight/dedup behavior.

duplicate_groups.note: Counts unique method+URL groups with more than one startup request.

writings_requests.note: Informational guard: second startup should be manifest plus at most one body batch.

collections_requests.note: Informational guard for collection hydration fan-out.

writing_collections_requests.note: Informational guard for collection membership hydration fan-out.

listener_churn_requests.note: After startup, Desk->Studio->Write navigation must not register/unregister Tauri menu listeners.
